decisions.reason: As a close extension of the existing water-control portfolio, the spring-controlled flap weir likely remains above a tolerable aspiration threshold for a first market year, and the firm can use organisational slack to give this infrastructure product more time despite modest website prominence.

The energy management system fits the firm's strategic move toward digitally networked, efficiency-oriented infrastructure solutions, so management would see enough strategic and performance potential relative to aspirations to continue supporting it.

Because the overflow flap gate was presented as a dedicated product line with several models and is closely tied to the firm's established business, management would infer comparatively strong acceptance and keep it on the market.
